Incident history (2)

📅 2025-09-22 Artillery Shelling INC-153
continuous shelling caused damage to the hospital and its aquipments, also obstructing the routes surrounding it

Announced relocation of the hospital from the Tal al Hawa area of Gaza city to Khan Younis, citing staff safety concerns. JAF noted that continuous shelling and heavy bombing in recent weeks had caused damage to the hospital’s façade and equipment, the hospital had become increasingly isolated, and the road leading to the hospital has become dangerous.

Sources: 🔗 unocha
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-15 Artillery Shelling INC-152
seven of the medical staff were injured

On 15 November, at about 20:30, a shell fired by Israeli forces hit the Jordanian field hospital in Gaza city, injuring seven of the medical team, who were members of the Jordanian Royal Medical Services.

7 health workers injured
